title: siginfo~

messages.description: signal information as messages, or one outlet per argument keyword

arguments.description: keywords choosing the outlets: dspstate, blocksize, channels, overlap, samplerate, samplespersecond

body: [siginfo~] reports the dspstate, blocksize, number of channels, overlap factor, samplerate and the number of samples processed per second (which is the sample rate times the overlap) of the signal connected to it. Most information (with the exception of the number of channels) is the same for all signals within a window.
